## Description

Removes files that come with the template but do not belong in a replication repository: `README.md` and the `build/` directory. It commits the removal as "Cleaning up". Without an argument, it does nothing.

## Usage

```bash
./automations/21_cleanup.sh <any argument>
```

The pipelines pass the deposit directory; only its presence matters.

### Environment Variables

- `SkipProcessing` - When `yes`, the script exits immediately.
- `jiraticket` - When set, commit messages start with `<jiraticket> #comment [skip ci]`; otherwise with `[skip ci]`.
